title: Pat's Cafe
prompt: Art-only event cover: square independent-magazine editorial photography. One strong focal object; natural side light, realistic materials, intentional crop, negative space. Restrained palette. No illustration, drawing, CGI, plastic gloss, neon or clutter. No text, letters, numerals, logos, ornate borders, confetti or cuisine stereotypes. No invented venue details or claims. The app adds all venue and time typography. Subject: one unbranded ceramic coffee cup. Palette: warm ivory, cobalt blue, muted tomato.
